aut cyminum, aut origa-num, vel etiam farris quicquam, vel corollam ullam, vel libum ullum commodet: Magnam enim, inquit, parua hæc tandem in anno sum-mam efficiunt. In sum-ma, fordidorum iftorum hominum loculos videas fitu obfitos, claues ferrugine illitas. Ipfos quinetiam videre licet veftes geftare intra quâ modicas: guttulos ex quibus unguantur paruulos habere: capite effe, ad cutem vsque attonfo: calceos medio die exuere: &cum fullonibus obnixè agere, vt ad poliendam fuam veftem, cretæ multum adhibeant, ne fordes facilè contrahat.

page.notes: Several Greek words are cut off at the right edge of the scan and are therefore only partly legible; those ends are marked [?] or left as far as they are visible. The Greek column is cut at the left edge; its fragments are read only in part and marked [?]. The Latin column is continuous, with no paragraph break visible. The "vsque" and "vt" forms are kept as printed, following the rule to keep the printed letters in the Latin column; only u/v and i/j are normalised where they are vowel or consonant respectively in the text.
